specifications.note: US sales figure; no RPM value asserted from this source.
Change capacity excludes oil remaining in engine.
Whole installed cooling system, not volume of engine water jackets.
Manual footnote includes0.6 L reserve tank and coolant remaining in engine.
Segmented inlet shaft system; do not draw two continuous full-length rocker shafts.
Current service catalogue number is not proof of original cam profile or lobe count.
Exact geometric derivation from 95 mm stroke; not an additional factory dimension.

unknowns.detail: KA/KL and exact emissions certification are unknown. Preserve both catalogues; ECU and catalyst differ. A catalogue selection cannot determine the user’s car.

Exact F22A6 cam lobe count, axial spacing, holder count, lobe width, lift law, opening/closing events and overlap were not established by a readable applicable primary source.16 valves / 16 rockers do not independently prove 16 lobes.

External dimensions, bore pitch, rod centre distance, pin offset, chamber geometry, wall thickness, oil-gallery routing and fastener spacing need dimensioned drawings or physical measurement. No scale can be inferred from shipping dimensions or uncalibrated photos.

OEM catalogue proves bypass body, diaphragm, vacuum tank, solenoid/check valve. Exact activation threshold, hysteresis, full vacuum routing and calibrated control logic remain unverified for the target.
A complete verified1993 US F22A6 workshop manual 61SM405 was not acquired. Do not label1996 F22B1 tolerances, valve clearances, tightening torques or timing settings as F22A6.

No set of six directional full-engine photographs with visible F22A6 stamp was verified. One1993 EX dealer engine-bay image supports shared exterior appearance only;60 exact OEM component service photos are available.

140 hp is verified in Honda’s1993 EX sedan brochure.5600 rpm / 142 lb-ft @ 4500 rpm are familiar secondary values but not promoted to verified here because the available primary table is too small to read confidently.
OEM diagram silhouettes and dealer service photographs do not establish alloy grades, internal surface finishes or production tolerances.

migration_audit.action: Keep explorer controls, PBR stage, parts navigation, speech/captions and inspection modes; replace identity strings and sources.
Keep shared-material extraction, camera rigs and media pipeline; regenerate images/videos after F22A6 geometry is accepted.
85mm bore and 95 mm stroke confirmed. Recheck all hidden dimensions and each OEM part; visual resemblance is not compatibility proof.

Remove B1 VTEC centre rockers, locking pistons, solenoid passages and switched cam profiles. Model8 inlet rockers as A×4 + B×4,8 exhaust, segmented inlet shafts. Hold exact cam topology as unresolved.
Black HONDA 16 VALVE cover,4 cap nuts, silver PGM-FI plenum, A6 intake bypass assembly and correct manifold/shield. Do not use original VTEC photo silhouette.
Separate manifold bypass actuator from throttle. Show vacuum diaphragm/shaft relationship as explanatory where detailed dimensions/control calibration remain unknown.
Use flywheel22100-PT7-013, clutch disc/pressure plate families,8 flywheel bolts and6 pressure plate bolts as catalogue references; no flexplate/torque converter.
Shared items may be represented; ECU/catalyst and unverified hose routing must retain unknown-market status.
Check every callout/PN against new JSON; supplier alternatives and supersessions are not extra simultaneous components. Recreate all affected captions, videos and explanations.
Remove hard-coded VTEC states,20-lobe assumptions, old timing/lift numbers, fixed flow coordinates and old 92-item assumptions. Test non-VTEC mechanics and5MT content.

catalogue_rules: Parts list row is a listing, not necessarily a distinct physical part.
Alternatives/supersessions should not inflate part counts.
quantity:null means source omitted quantity; do not replace with1 without evidence.
Exploded diagrams establish topology/identity, not scale.
Actual OEM photos represent supplied service parts; historical factory finish is not guaranteed.
Only photos from confirmed matching assemblies may establish shape; earlierVTEC photos are historical.
